faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about Skill2Study.

items.question: What is Skill2Study?
items.answer: Skill2Study is an intelligent platform for university guidance after the Bac in Madagascar. It uses advanced algorithms to analyze your profile and recommend the fields and universities best suited to you.

items.question: Is Skill2Study free?
items.answer: Yes, Skill2Study is completely free for students. The platform was developed as part of a final year project to democratize access to university guidance.

items.question: Who can use Skill2Study?
items.answer: Skill2Study is aimed at Malagasy bachelor's students and students wishing to reorient themselves. Anyone looking for information about universities in Madagascar can also benefit from it.

items.question: How long does an orientation test take?
items.answer: The duration varies depending on the test. The academic personality test takes about 15 minutes, the aptitude test 20 minutes, and the complete test about 30 minutes. You can see the estimated duration before starting.

items.question: Can I retake a test?
items.answer: Yes, you can retake a test as many times as you like. Your previous results are kept in your history so you can track your progress.

items.question: How are the results calculated?
items.answer: Our algorithms analyze your answers along several dimensions: cognitive abilities, personality traits, interests and practical preferences. Each dimension is weighted to generate a complete profile.

items.question: How are recommendations generated?
items.answer: Recommendations are based on the match between your profile (test results, Bac series, preferences) and the characteristics of available fields. A compatibility score is calculated for each field.

items.question: Are the recommendations reliable?
items.answer: Our recommendations are a decision-making tool, not a final decision. They are based on real data and validated algorithms, but we encourage you to supplement them with personal research and consultations.

items.question: Can I filter recommendations by city?
items.answer: Yes! You can filter by city, type of institution (public/private), field of study and budget. The interactive map also allows you to explore universities by location.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes, we take security very seriously. Your personal data is encrypted and never shared with third parties. You can delete your account and all your data at any time.

items.question: How do I modify my profile?
items.answer: Go to your dashboard, then click "Profile" in the side menu. You can modify your personal information, your Bac series and your interests.

items.question: I forgot my password, what should I do?
items.answer: On the login page, click "Forgot Password". A reset email will be sent to you. If you don't receive it, check your spam or contact us.

guide.title: User Guide
guide.description: Follow these simple steps to get the most out of Skill2Study and find the ideal training.

steps.title: 1. Create an account
steps.description: Sign up with your email and basic information (Bac series, city, interests). This allows us to personalize your experience.

steps.title: 2. Take an orientation test
steps.description: Choose from available tests and answer the questions. Each test evaluates your abilities, personality and academic preferences.

steps.title: 3. View your results
steps.description: After the test, a detailed score table shows your strengths in each field: sciences, humanities, management, technology, etc.

steps.title: 4. Explore the recommendations
steps.description: Our algorithm proposes the fields and universities best suited to your profile. Each recommendation includes a compatibility score.

steps.title: 5. Compare universities
steps.description: Use the comparison tool to compare up to 3 universities side by side: fees, duration, career prospects, location.

steps.title: 6. Explore the interactive map
steps.description: View all universities on the Madagascar map. Click on a city to discover available institutions and access their details.
